# ezghcloud_oidc_provider (Resource)

Manage an EZGH Cloud oidc_provider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `audiences` (Set of String) The audiences values.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer value.
- `name` (String) The name value.

### Optional

- `jwks_json` (String) Null or omitted uses issuer discovery; a public JWKS JSON object uploads keys. Switching between discovery and uploaded keys replaces the provider; rotating uploaded key contents updates it in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id value.
- `key_source` (String) The keySource value.
- `organization_id` (String) The  value.
- `resource_name` (String) The resourceName value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_oidc_provider.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROVIDER_ID'
```
